notes.title: Chinese Build Fixed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is a quick update, just letting you know we've spoken to Valve and the issue has now been fixed. If you do not get an automatic update to download, try restarting the Steam Client. If it still does not auto-initiate, try verifying the cache. We've now confirmed it is working again. Very sorry for the inconvenience! 

As a reminder as well, please make sure you are playing the game on chinese locale for this version, or characters will not appear correctly in-game.

notes.title: Quick Note on Chinese Language Version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This is a quick warning regarding the current status of the chinese version of the game. Because the chinese and english version(s) are separate downloadable depots instead of a singular option within game, usually there are two versions of the game which download respectively depending on language options. It appears that at the moment, there is a major bug happening on Valve's end which has caused the chinese version to not download. when changing to chinese, it shows as downloaded (and with the correct file size - 73 MB), but it does not actually download from Steam. 

We have gone ahead and verified the backend is setup correctly, as well as testing this bug ourselves to verify it seems to be happening. Because of this, things are currently out of our hands, but we have reported the bug to Valve/Steam for fixing. Once it is is fixed we will update everyone. We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Now Available in Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We are happy to say that the game is now available in Simplified Chinese. If your Steam client is configured for this language by default, the game will auto-launch in this language. Otherwise, you can change the language in the properties settings in the steam library, under the language tab.

[b]PLEASE NOTE THE GAME MUST BE PLAYED ON A CHINESE SYSTEM LOCALE FOR CHARACTERS TO LOAD CORRECTLY.[/b]

We are also happy to say that we are currently working on trading cards, which will be coming very soon.

notes.title: Girls and Dungeons 2 Now Live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Just a quick announcement that the sequel to the game is now live on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096750/Girls__Dungeons_2/

Girls & Dungeons 2 features a hi-fidelity, reworked pixel graphics style and refined gameplay and features, noting feedback received on the first game. It features new areas, characters, stories, and more!

Some features include;
[list]
[*]     An estimated 11-15 hours of diving in bewitching booze - themed dungeons
[*]     Protect your maidens via classic, turn-based JRPG battle system
[*]     Mysterious and surprising 'spirit sanctuaries'; full of fierce critters and lewd secrets to unveil
[*]     Bartending-action: serve your maiden of choice liquor, in order to dive deeper into the dungeon.
[*]     Lots of custom actions and animations in battles focused on protection and strategy
[*]     Try to trigger the spirit-maiden's "Potential" to annihilate your enemies in a swoop!
[*]     Mysticards: collect, use and equip magical cards to power up your party in any way you see fit
[/list]

A free uncensor patch is up on our website as well. Happy dungeon crawling!

notes.title: Girls and Dungeons 2 - Coming Soon! Steam Page Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce for all fans of Girls & Dungeons that a standalone sequel is coming soon! It features new features, areas, characters, and shiny new graphics. It's currently scheduled for sometime over the summer. More information on it's release soon! In the meantime, you can check out the store page here;

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096750/Girls__Dungeons_2/

Be sure to follow and wishlist to be notified of its release!

notes.title: Project Sense is on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Hopefully everyone is enjoying Girls & Dungeons. While we wait for a followup, a friend of ours has put their kickstarter live recently.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2030067069/project-sense-a-cyberpunk-ghost-story-adventure?ref=user_menu

The game is a mix between old school adventure games such as Clock Tower with lots of inspiration from blade runner & fatal frame. There's also quite a bit of fanservice if that's your thing. 

If it looks interesting to you, be sure to check out.

notes.title: Uncensor Patch & Guide To Install
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

Thanks to cooperation with the developer and one our players, we were able to get an uncensor patch coordinated and released.

Please note that this contains sexual content and is not suitable for minors under the age of 18.

The patch can be downloaded from here:
http://tophatentertainment.us/patches/Game.rgssad

After downloading, find the Steam base folder, then "steamapps", then "common", then finally, "Girls and Dungeons". Select the downloaded file and move it to this directory, overwriting the existing file.

This should be all that is needed.

If you have any questions (or just want to chat), join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/Qphynem

or follow us on social media for updates:
https://twitter.com/TopHatStudiosEN
https://www.facebook.com/tophatstudiosEN/

notes.title: Regarding The Water Cave
notes.notes:
Since release, we've noticed a lot of valid criticism regarding a very tough puzzle in the "Water Cave" area of the game. After talking with the developer, we thought, who better to ask about the area than the heroines of the game? Let's see what they have to say...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30339176/24fe51a9d16995c126858b67172963a35addd59b.jpg[/img]

We will be releasing a patch within the next few coming days that will clarify this further in-game, as the current hint is very ambiguous. We apologize for any trouble this may have caused players.

On a separate note, for those looking for an uncensor patch for the CGs, we're currently looking into providing one in the near future. We will post another update once we have more news about this.
